description: Verify that DHCPDISCOVER 'flags' field has reserved bits (1..15) set to 0 (RFC 2131 §2 Protocol Summary MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The DHCP `flags` field is 16 bits but RFC 2131 §2 only defines bit 0 (the Broadcast flag). Bits 1..15 are reserved and must be sent as 0; future extensions could redefine them, so today's clients must not stamp arbitrary values.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER
   • flags & 0x7FFF == 0 (only the broadcast bit may be set)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DISCOVER's reserved flag bits are all zero.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_reserved_flags_nonzero — at least one of bits 1..15 is set
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DISCOVER reserved flag bits are zero — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
